premises.text: Enterprise knowledge is siloed in emails, IMs, and conversations, so employees repeat work and make mistakes
premises.evidence_span: all the knowledge was siloed. It was siloed in emails, IMs, conversations. There was no good knowledge base.

premises.text: Melding Q&A power with wiki flexibility creates an organically growing, easily searchable knowledge base organized around questions
premises.evidence_span: So we take the power of a Q&A site, meld it with the flexibility of wikis to create a really organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise.

premises.text: Verified corporate email sign-up gates each company network
premises.evidence_span: signs up for Opsy using their corporate email address, which we then verify

premises.text: Endorsement voting and enterprise-appropriate anonymity fit how knowledge is validated and surfaced inside companies
premises.evidence_span: We have a voting mechanic that allows people to stand behind and endorse certain answers, which is very important in the enterprise context.

premises.text: A fast, powerful search engine lets people find previous answers
premises.evidence_span: we have a very fast, very powerful search engine that allows people to find previous answers to questions that they have already

premises.text: Deep email integration lets users ask and answer by email, extracts listserv content into the index, and routes questions to likely answerers
premises.evidence_span: We know that people and companies live in their Outlook email boxes, and so that's where we'd like to interact and integrate with them.

value.text: People at companies share knowledge and find the answers they need
value.evidence_span: Opsy's mission is to help people at companies share knowledge.
